fields.Detail:
Urgent care locations

LCMC Health urgent care clinics offer convenient walk-in evaluation for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries.

Locations across greater New Orleans help patients find prompt care closer to home when a primary care visit cannot wait.
fields.pageSummary: Find convenient LCMC Health walk-in urgent care locations across greater New Orleans.
fields.metadataDescription: Find LCMC Health urgent care locations.

fields.Detail:
LCMC Health Chalmette Urgent Care

The Chalmette clinic provides walk-in care for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries in St. Bernard Parish.

Patients can receive prompt local evaluation and guidance about follow-up when additional care is needed.

LCMC Health Clearview Urgent Care

The Clearview clinic provides convenient walk-in evaluation for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries.

LCMC Health urgent care teams treat everyday needs and direct patients to follow-up or emergency services when appropriate.

LCMC Health Gretna Urgent Care

The Gretna clinic offers walk-in care for illnesses and injuries that need prompt attention but are not emergencies.

Its Westbank location connects patients with local evaluation and the broader LCMC Health system when follow-up is needed.

LCMC Health Kenner Urgent Care

The Kenner clinic provides walk-in care for common illnesses and minor injuries that need timely attention.

Patients can receive local evaluation and guidance about primary, specialty, or emergency follow-up when necessary.

LCMC Health Lakeview Urgent Care

The Lakeview clinic offers walk-in evaluation for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries.

The neighborhood location helps patients access prompt care and connects them with other LCMC Health services when needed.

LCMC Health Luling Urgent Care

Luling Urgent Care is represented with information from LCMC Health's broader urgent care network because a dedicated live page was not available.

The topic connects patients with walk-in care for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries and guidance about additional services when needed.
fields.pageSummary: Learn about LCMC Health walk-in urgent care options serving the Luling area.
fields.metadataDescription: Find LCMC Health urgent care details.

fields.Detail:
LCMC Health Marrero Urgent Care

The Marrero clinic provides walk-in care for everyday illnesses and minor injuries that require prompt attention.

Patients on the Westbank can receive local evaluation and connect with other LCMC Health care when follow-up is appropriate.

LCMC Health Uptown Urgent Care

The Uptown clinic offers walk-in care for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries in New Orleans.

Its convenient neighborhood setting helps patients receive timely evaluation without using a hospital emergency department for routine urgent needs.
